initial_conditions.onset_s: duration_s, no phase modulation for cold capture

measurement.lock_time_definition: earliest beginning after final invalid block with >=10 valid terminal blocks

limitations: No global initial-condition coverage or absolute nonlockability result
M1 BW/PM do not predict or certify capture time
Protocol permits pair-converged noncapture; this must be reported failure/unknown under an explicit finite-window requirement
Original 100 ppm capture tracking gate cannot replace frozen 1 microHz frequency equality
Lock time is quantized by 1 us blocks; research deadline should include resolution and two-step hull
Existing kernel has deterministic initial phase and LF-state coupling; no thermal/noise/random-start evidence
Capture measurement reliability still needs actual paired runs and one repeated pair; static review alone is not repeatability proof
